actual_decoded_result.interpretation: Scheduled-running is scheduler residency, not proof of instructions executing, no interrupts, or stall cause. Numeric TID identity must be joined externally to the component receipt.
actual_decoded_result.coverage_rule: Finalized single sequential file; zero reported loss; ProcessTrace EOF; documented scheduler events bracket raw QPC interval. Circular overwrite continuity is unproven and rejected as UNKNOWN.

same_cpu_timeline.selection: Earliest target switch-in/out CPU inside the requested window; ReadyThread logging CPU does not select target residency.
same_cpu_timeline.interpretation: Adjacent matching switch edges show scheduler residence, not instructions executing or stall cause. Priorities are edge values; intervening priority changes and PID or TID lifetime are unobserved. No residence is attributed if the scan or fixed record retention is incomplete.
same_cpu_timeline.raw_edge_sample_selection: First at most 32 retained same-CPU edges sorted by QPC; equal timestamps have no inferred event order.

actual_decoded_result.wait_reason_interpretation: Numeric switch-out reason is descriptive metadata; interval reason is retained only for an attributed waiting span. It does not establish the producer stall cause.

scope: Original ETL reader only. Same-CPU residency and numeric priority edges are bounded scheduler observations; no process attribution, TID lifetime proof, cause, controller final-statistics qualification, recording, producer, auditor or live qualification.
